name: Gage Run Chart
description: Plots every single measurement grouped by part and appraiser against a common reference line — reveals appraiser bias and unusual parts.
whenToUse: Look at a measurement system study before computing statistics: every measurement per part and operator, against a reference line.
operatorHint: Optional — without an operator column one series per part is drawn.
refValueHint: Leave empty to use the mean of all measurements.
warn_unbalanced: Unbalanced design — not every part × operator combination has the same number of measurements.
warnDroppedRows: {count} row(s) skipped: empty part or non-numeric measurement.
errNoData: No usable measurements in the selected columns.
